environment.description: Kubernetes pod with SecurityContext specifying runAsNonRoot:true (uid 1000), readOnlyRootFilesystem:true, and a custom seccomp profile (runtime/default variant with additional blocked syscalls). The pod spec includes securityContext.capabilities.drop containing ALL, with only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE added back. An emptyDir volume is mounted at /tmp/diagnostics with sizeLimit 1Ki. The container also has resource limits (memory: 256Mi, cpu: 200m) and the node runs a PodSecurityPolicy (legacy cluster) enforcing MustRunAsNonRoot and forbidding hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC. Network policy restricts egress to only port 5432 (postgres) on 10.0.0.0/8.
